text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data — examples with correct answers — so it can find patterns. From this data, it builds a model that can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can learn to recognise spam emails by studying many labelled examples. After training, we test the model to check its accuracy, which means how often its predictions are correct. The better the training data, the more accurate the model usually becomes.
